title: How not to rob a bank
summary: This is a humor anthology of short jokes, pranks, mock advice pieces, and newsgroup-style lore, gathered in a joke-collection format. The pieces include a tongue-in-cheek guide to bank robbery, drawn from a 1987 Old Farmer's Almanac article, which lists ten ways robbers fail, with examples of holdups gone wrong. Other sections satirize condom buying and etiquette, invent slogans for a condom awareness week, and offer a mock feminist story about a fiancee and God. There are also military slang about 'FUBAR' and its variants, a tech-themed condom for computers, a sculptor's fairy tale, Iranian T-shirt slogans, a German beer-glass anecdote, a parody song sung to 'My Way' about academic life, and a series of elephant riddles. The tone is bawdy, irreverent, and dry throughout. Many items are short and self-contained, so the book reads as a grab bag rather than a continuous narrative. The excerpts suggest the text is a loosely assembled, sometimes crude collection that mixes original writing with circulated internet jokes and newspaper clippings.
